review_evidence: Inventoried all 556 primary Lean files across eight unsorry archive packages (0006, 0055, 0061, 0083, 0086, 0105, 0111 and 0130): exactly 278 goal files and 278 paired library files.

A complete source-shape scan found a theorem/lemma/definition-style declaration in every one of the 556 files. All 278 goal files contain sorry as the proof hole for their mathematical statement, while none of the 278 paired library files contains sorry.

Representative files cover coprimality, modular-power, Fibonacci, inequality and divisibility statements and their corresponding proved modules. No file in the reviewed unit is only build, import, audit or regression infrastructure.
summary: Reviewed this eight-package unsorry archive slice; all 556 files are mathematical goal statements or corresponding proved library modules, so the complete unit remains primary-retained.
